text:
mira: kicking off onboarding for halcyon9b v1.0 (int4) on ded-pool-7. quick runs look fine but we're seeing "mem fragmentation" after long convo sims
raj: what does "mem fragmentation" look like in the logs? OOMs or slow allocation spikes?
jordan: tagging perf-bot for traces @perf-bot
perf-bot: added perf trace https://perf.internal/runs/2067890123 (kv pressure + several small allocations at step ~12k) :mag:
sophia: can you paste the minimal repro?
mira: repro below (shortened):
```python
prompt = open('redteam_prompt.txt').read()
resp = client.generate(model='halcyon9b-int4', prompt=prompt, max_new_tokens=256, batch_size=4, stream=False)
```
mira: observed behaviour: stable for ~500 tokens, then allocation spikes, minor OOMs on canaries (1/50), and kv cache prune churn
raj: try lowering max_new_tokens to 128 and enable adaptive KV trim (aggressive) to see if it stabilizes
jordan: also reduce batch_max_tokens per worker. halcyon has larger headroom for batch concurrency but int4 layout increases allocator fragmentation
mira: ran those changes: max_new_tokens=128 + adaptive_kv_trim=aggressive + batch_max_tokens=1024 -> eliminated OOMs on canary, tail latency improved ~12%
sophia: any quality regressions after int4 quant + new defaults? we need eval numbers on our red-team and qa suites
mira: ran evals (1000 prompts, mixed QA/dialog):
- baseline fp16 (dedicated): qa acc 0.823
- int4, defaults (256): qa acc 0.792 (drop 3.1%)
- int4, tuned (128 + kv_trim): qa acc 0.801 (drop 2.2% vs fp16)
notes: hallucination cases reduced slightly vs untuned int4 but still above fp16
jordan: curious if post-quant per-channel calibration helps. Sophia, can you run a quick per-channel scale sweep on a subset?
sophia: scheduling a 5k-step calibration job, will compare ppl and QA metrics by EOD
mira: also tried a lightweight prefix cache TTL change (prefetch=true, prefix_ttl=30s) which reduced repeated KV recompute and smoothed allocations
perf-bot: snapshots: memory peak reduced from 34.8GB -> 29.1GB with tuned defaults, 95th latency reduced 160ms -> 140ms
mira: plan: roll tuned defaults to canary 10% on ded-pool-7 (halcyon9b-int4) and run eval hooks (red-team + QA + perf traces). if QA drop >1.5% revert. also keep max_new_tokens default set to 128 for this model.
raj: add a config note to model catalog that halcyon9b-int4 defaults differ from other 9b models (reason: quant frag & kv pressure).
mira: done — added entry in catalog and linked perf trace. will post final canary results in this thread. :thumbsup:
